scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 48 boards from four live Deity 6p Continents Online Science-seat games of 2026-11-18 whose Universities lagged Education (civvis-20261118T192816Z Japan, -T152649Z Korea, -T205036Z Persia, -T201051Z Japan), every fifth turn from t75 to t130, each the run's events.jsonl cut after turn N+1 and replayed at turn N. Both arms run one frozen ci-profile civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 922efb9065 with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 forced, trade-district-follows-the-campus included); the on arm adds --with science-universities-pass-the-claims. 40 boards completed in both arms; the other 8 (civvis-20261118T205036Z at t95-t130) did not run, because that run's events.jsonl ends at t94 (the game continued in a -cont1 directory the cut does not read), so the cut held no state row; their result.json files keep the error and are not members. Orders differ on 15 of them (by run: civvis-20261118T192816Z 0 of 12; civvis-20261118T152649Z 9 of 12; civvis-20261118T205036Z 2 of 12; civvis-20261118T201051Z 4 of 12); the on arms journal 20 'science-universities-pass-the-claims:' lines and the off arms 0. The University went ahead of: 8 the Industrial Zone, 4 the Workshop, 3 the Harbor, 2 the Commercial Hub, 2 the Market, 1 quadrireme. 19 of those claims end the frame as the city's production order and 1 lost the queue later in the same frame. Production orders for a University (or Madrasa, Navigation School) number 9 in the off arms and 27 in the on arms.
